description: IoT Village highlights embedded firmware analysis, smart device reverse engineering, hardware security research tools, and connected device vulnerability disclosure.

talks.title: IoT Hacking Stories in Real Life
talks.teaser: Shares real-world case studies and practical lessons learned from testing and hacking consumer IoT devices.

talks.title: Hacking Smart Devices for Fun and Profit
talks.teaser: Explores vulnerability discovery techniques and exploitation workflows targeting connected smart devices.

talks.title: Future of IoT Sec Baselines
talks.teaser: Examines the evolution of security baselines, regulatory compliance, and standardization frameworks for connected IoT devices.

talks.title: Your Connected World Isn't Yours Now
talks.teaser: Analyzes privacy risks, data leakage, and device takeover vulnerabilities across consumer smart home ecosystems.

talks.title: NAND Flash Recovering File Systems
talks.teaser: Details techniques for dumping raw NAND flash chips, reconstructing wear-leveled blocks, and recovering embedded filesystems.

talks.title: Getting Started Building an IoT Hardware Hacking Lab
talks.teaser: Guides defenders and researchers through assembling an affordable hardware hacking workbench with essential tools and equipment.

talks.title: Vulnerabilities in Smart Sex Toys
talks.teaser: Examines severe privacy flaws, Bluetooth Low Energy vulnerabilities, and cloud data risks in connected smart devices.

talks.title: How to Get Rights for Hackers
talks.teaser: Advocates for legal protections, safe harbor frameworks, and policy reforms to shield security researchers from prosecution.

talks.title: Stepped on a Nail
talks.teaser: Presents an embedded hardware research case study dissecting device security architecture and unexpected failure modes.

talks.title: VULNtron: 4 CVEs Turn a Teleconference Bot into a Spy
talks.teaser: Chains four CVEs in a commercial telepresence robot to achieve remote code execution and covert surveillance.

talks.title: IoT Honeypots and Taming Rogue Appliances
talks.teaser: Explains how to deploy IoT honeypots to capture malicious scanning and isolate rogue appliances on home networks.

talks.title: Learning to Use Logic Analyzers
talks.teaser: Demonstrates how to capture, decode, and interpret serial communication protocols using hardware logic analyzers.

talks.title: Introduction to U-Boot Interaction and Hacking
talks.teaser: Walks through interacting with the U-Boot bootloader via serial console to extract firmware and alter boot parameters.

talks.title: Vulnerability Trends in the Supply Chain
talks.teaser: Examines recurring vulnerability patterns, outdated third-party SDKs, and component reuse across IoT supply chains.

talks.title: The Joy of Coordinating Vulnerability Disclosure
talks.teaser: Panelists discuss the realities, communication hurdles, and diplomatic nuances of coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

talks.title: Kicking Devices, Taking CVEs: Zoomer Guide to Hacking
talks.teaser: Offers practical guidance and methodology for young security researchers starting out in IoT vulnerability hunting.

talks.title: Hella Booters, Why IoT Botnets Aren't Going Anywhere
talks.teaser: Analyzes the persistent economics, attack vectors, and lifecycle of IoT botnets driving modern DDoS-for-hire services.

talks.title: Pandemic in Plaintext
talks.teaser: Reveals how medical and consumer IoT devices deployed during the COVID-19 pandemic transmitted sensitive data in plaintext.

talks.title: In Search of the Perfect UPnP Tool
talks.teaser: Surveys existing UPnP assessment tools, highlighting protocol flaws, NAT traversal risks, and custom tooling.
